name: SoundMode
meaning: ProgressOptionBits.soundMode, the options menu's sound setting (cycled % 3; its labels are g_soundModeNames, BSM group 0x10 strings 0x1000 / 0x2000 / 0x4000)

name: SOUNDMODE_ALL
meaning: "All" (BSM 0x10/0x1000): sound effects, music and voices (verified: GREET_txt.BSM; Sound_Play plays in modes 0 and 2, the stream player only in 0 per OPT_SOUNDMODE_MASK)

name: SOUNDMODE_NONE
meaning: "None" (BSM 0x10/0x2000): Sound_Play refuses every sound and the stream player plays nothing (verified: GREET_txt.BSM)

name: SOUNDMODE_SFX_ONLY
meaning: "Sfx only" (BSM 0x10/0x4000): sound effects without music or voices (verified: GREET_txt.BSM)
